constraints: Do not alter any existing Sanatani theme, colors, fonts, or layout.
Do not modify backend logic or data models.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Sanskrit terms already present in the UI (e.g., शाश्वत प्रकृति, भक्ति योग) should be preserved as-is.
Organization name 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA' in the HTML title and logo should remain unchanged.
nonGoals: Adding multi-language toggle or i18n infrastructure — all text should be directly replaced with Hindi.
Translating backend error messages or Motoko code.
Changing any visual design, layout, or component structure.
Modifying the ads.txt or any public asset files.
